d: Pale ash-blonde wavy hair with long bangs is styled with a teal headband and a high side ponytail. The wide, bright sky-blue eyes have a gentle expression on a youthful face. A slender build is dressed in a grey school uniform consisting of a long-sleeved shirt, a grey v-neck sweater vest, a grey sleeveless blazer with gold buttons, a red necktie, and matching grey shorts. Accessories include a red ribbon pinned to the chest, white knee-high socks, and polished black loafers.
